title: 第五章 我王腾很勤奋第六章 我真不是战五渣
content_zh:
十一点，夜已深沉。
王腾从极星武馆离开，一脸意犹未尽。
别人训练了一晚上，他则是厮混了一晚上。
厮混？
呸呸……武者的事情怎么能说是厮混！
其他武徒学员也相继离开，王腾是最后一批。
不是他有多努力，而是为了不漏掉任何一个属性气泡，嗯……这也是一种努力。
王腾驱车行驶在无人的街道上。
【悟性】：19.3
【体质】：47
【力量】：135
【速度】：86
【战技】：基础拳法（粗通），基础身法（粗通）
瞄了一眼属性面板，心满意足。
从最初的个位数，到现在双位数，三位数属性，变化无疑是巨大的。
力量和速度提升最多，而悟性和体质相对较少。
不难看出来，各种属性掉落的概率存在一定差异性。
令他意外的是，今晚还得到了基础拳法和基础身法，一个武者，光有强悍的身体是不行的，必须要学会战技，才能发挥出应有的实力。
“明天再来武馆，去测试一下，看看我能到什么程度？”
王腾想道。

回到家里，李秀梅准备了宵夜。
王盛国正在吃着，看到王腾回来，皱眉问道：“这么晚，去哪里了？”
“去了一趟极星武馆。”
王腾随口答道。
然后又冲李秀梅道：“妈，你煮了鸡蛋面啊，有没有给我留点儿？我饿了。”
“有！
给你留着呢。”
儿子喜欢自己煮的东西，李秀梅很高兴。
吸溜吸溜~
王腾接过碗，坐在王盛国旁边，大口的吃了起来，吃的格外香。
王盛国没有在王腾身上闻到酒味，眉头微微松开，诧异的问道：“你去武馆做什么？”
“我去练武了！”
王腾头也不抬的说道。
“练武！”
“练武！”
王盛国和李秀梅都吃了一惊，两个人不由对视一眼，然后齐齐看向王腾。
他们以前劝过王腾，但是王腾从小娇生惯养，又不学无术，根本没把他们的话放心上。
现在他居然主动要学武？
“儿子，你要练武？”
李秀梅有些不相信的的问道。
content_en:
At eleven o'clock, the night is deep.
Wang Teng left the Jixing Martial Arts School with a look of unfulfilled satisfaction.
While others trained all night, he hung out all night.
Hanging out?
Bah, bah... How can we call the matter of warriors just messing around!
Other martial arts students also left one after another, Wang Teng was the last group.
It's not about how hard he works, but in order not to miss any attribute bubble, well... this is also an effort.
Wang Teng drove on a deserted street.
【Comprehension】：19.3
[Physique]: 47
【Power】: 135
[Speed]: 86
[Combat Skills]: Basic boxing skills (proficient), basic body skills (proficient)
I glanced at the properties panel and was satisfied.
From the initial single digits to the current double and triple digit properties, the change is undoubtedly huge.
Strength and speed are improved the most, while understanding and physique are relatively less.
It is not difficult to see that there are certain differences in the probability of dropping various attributes.
To his surprise, he also got basic boxing skills and basic body skills tonight. A warrior cannot just have a strong body. He must learn combat skills in order to display his due strength.
"Come to the martial arts gym tomorrow to test and see how far I can go?"
Wang Teng thought.
Back home, Li Xiumei prepared a midnight snack.
Wang Shengguo was eating. When he saw Wang Teng coming back, he frowned and asked, "Where have you been so late?"
"Went to Ji Xing Martial Arts School."
Wang Teng replied casually.
Then he said to Li Xiumei: "Mom, you cooked the egg noodles, did you leave some for me? I'm hungry."
"Yes!
I've left it for you. "
Li Xiumei is very happy that her son likes what she cooks.
Suck, suck, suck~
Wang Teng took the bowl, sat next to Wang Shengguo, and ate it in big mouthfuls. The food tasted particularly delicious.
Wang Shengguo didn't smell the smell of alcohol on Wang Teng, so he relaxed his brows slightly and asked in surprise: "What are you doing in the martial arts gym?"
"I'm going to practice martial arts!"
Wang Teng said without raising his head.
"Practice martial arts!"
"Practice martial arts!"
Wang Shengguo and Li Xiumei were both surprised. They couldn't help but look at each other, and then both looked at Wang Teng.
They had tried to persuade Wang Teng before, but Wang Teng had been spoiled since childhood and was uneducated, so he didn't take their words at all.
Now he actually wants to learn martial arts?
"Son, do you want to practice martial arts?"
Li Xiumei asked in disbelief.
